title: Cant use without it being plugged in…
text:
Cant use without it being plugged in…. Wanting for dry skin in dire need of moisture but, unfortunately it was a bit of a struggle to make it happen with this particular humidifier. Small in size this fits nicely on a windowsill, in drink holder, etc.. has a very small footprint and uses up minimal space.

Info is NOT clear online- so, if expecting this to be mobile..?? Let’s just say it is small enough to pack + carry but, it MUST be constantly plugged into its power source in order to function!!! This does NOT run using rechargeable battery option.. something that seemed unclear- **portable is referring to its size only!!

Instructions included are a bit confusing and may take a bit trial/error to learn varied features. **Basically x1 button rules it all which is not my favorite style as its easy to miscount or, mix up command order. Modes are selected by depressing x1 power, x2 intermittent spray, x3 power off, x4 continuous, etc.. and a button for light variation if desired.

100% be sure cotton rod is saturated prior to use- (runs like straw thru middle!) Otherwise, machine shuts down- as it happened to us! All kinks aside: when filled completely + set on intermittent bursts -ours lasted approx. 3.20 hr. not the 6hrs. stated..?? While in use this disperses a solid, quality spritz but problem was after only 3hrs. the tank was 100% out of h2o!! As much as I appreciate auto safety shut down- (and it does work btw!) The amount of time was far less than expected by almost half.

Overall, this best suited for day use when one can tend to water levels if wanting this to run for longer periods of time! I appreciate sensitive safety shut downs (we had x2 for different issues.. giving us the confidence they will respond.) Although not “fully mobile” with battery option this is a small unit that can produce a nice spritz. Hoping this info may help in your decision.. stay safe everyone!

product_metadata.title: Portable Mini Humidifier, 300ml Small Cool Mist Humidifier with Colorful LED Night Light, USB Personal Desktop Humidifier for Car Office Home Travel, Auto Shut-Off, 2 Mist Modes, Super Quiet(pink)
features: Mini humidifier: Small design, convenient to take with you anywhere. Ideal for car, travel, bedroom, office, effectively moisturize dry skin and help you reduce skin peeling, nose bleeding.
USB Only: Without battery. The USB is compatible with the USB port of any device,safe and easy to use.

Two Spray Modes and automatic shutdown: Continuous spray & intermittent spray. Click the spray button for the first time to activate continuous spray mode. Click the spray button a second time, switch to the intermittent spray mode, click the spray button for the third time, turn off the spray. In continuous mode, it will automatically turn off after 4 hours. In intermittent mode, it will automatically turn off after 6 hours. It will shut down when the water level is low.

Vivid and colorful circulating lights and luminous: This cool mist humidifier has a vivid and colorful setting of circulating lights to create a tranquil atmosphere while providing soothing fog. It provides you with maximum relaxation. Night lights can improve your sleep quality.

KIND REMINDER: ①Do not use essential oils, perfume, distilled water, which will cause the cotton swab to clog and the Humidifier to be unusable. ②Please make sure the cotton core has soaked a few minutes before you turning it on. ③Any quality problem, please do feel free to email us.
